text: The subject Hira Shah holds account PK**HABB****3642 which was opened on 23 February 2022. The subject is declared as a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 30,000 per month. During the activity window from 3 April 2026 to 11 April 2026 the account recorded 16 credits totalling PKR 1,018,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 910,000. All 16 credits arrived as interbank (IBFT) transfers from 15 distinct senders. The activity was flagged by Tazama on 11 April 2026, with the Tazama typology MULE-01 scoring 360 against a threshold of 300. Debits equal to 89% of credits and a median of 1.1 hours between the latest credit and each debit suggest that most inbound value leaves the account within hours. Credits amounting to 33.9 times the declared monthly income of PKR 30,000 per month for a Student are inconsistent with the customer profile. Two sender banks raised fraud recall requests against inbound transfers to this account, citing scam complaints. Overall, the pattern of many distinct senders, rapid outflow, and activity levels far exceeding a Student’s declared income is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 609,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 2 transactions. PKR 301,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. Screening on 29 April 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse‑media lists. L2 analyst (12 April 2026): "Outgoing wallet transfers placed on hold pending review. No contact made with the customer about this review."
